items.question: What was Shey Peddy's highest-scoring WNBA season?
items.answer: Shey Peddy's highest-scoring WNBA season was 2022 with the Phoenix Mercury, when she averaged 9.9 points, 3.8 rebounds and 3.4 assists in 34 games. In 2025 she played 9 games for the Indiana Fever and 6 for the Los Angeles Sparks.

items.question: How old is Shey Peddy?
items.answer: Shey Peddy was born October 28, 1988, in Boston, Massachusetts.

items.question: Which teams has Shey Peddy played for?
items.answer: Shey Peddy has played for the Washington Mystics, Phoenix Mercury, Los Angeles Sparks and Indiana Fever.

items.question: How tall is Shey Peddy?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Shey Peddy at 5 feet 7 inches and 145 pounds. She is a guard.

items.question: What was Shey Peddy's buzzer beater?
items.answer: Shey Peddy hit a game-winning 3-pointer as time expired for the Phoenix Mercury against the Washington Mystics in Round 1 of the 2020 WNBA Playoffs on September 15, 2020. It gave Phoenix a one-point win, and she finished with 12 points, four rebounds and three steals.

items.question: Where did Shey Peddy play college basketball?
items.answer: Shey Peddy played two seasons at Wright State and then two at Temple. As a senior at Temple she led her conference in scoring at 17.6 points per game, and the Chicago Sky drafted her 23rd overall in 2012. She made her WNBA debut with Washington in 2019.

items.question: Where has Shey Peddy played overseas?
items.answer: Shey Peddy has played professionally in Israel, Austria, Germany and Latvia.
